El curso también cubre la gestión de productos, servicios y proveedores, así como el uso de moneda extranjera y funciones avanzadas de QuickBooks.

title: Curso de Preparación para el CDA Nacional (Padron Campus)
description: Este curso de preparación ayudará a los estudiantes que han completado las 120 horas de entrenamiento de cuidado infantil a capacitarse para obtener su certificación nacional (CDA). Al finalizar el curso, los estudiantes estarán listos para poder presentar su solicitud para el “National CDA”.
prerequisiteText: Haber finalizado la educación secundaria o doce grados. Educación profesional (120 horas), incluyendo 10 horas en cada una de las 8 áreas temáticas CDA. Experiencia laboral (480 horas) trabajando con niños de 3 a 5 años. Tarjeta de CPR – First Aid vigente.
note: Public CE listing snapshot; sections/fees are as displayed at fetch time and can change. Non-credit; not degree credit.

title: Entendiendo el TDAH y el Autismo (Padron Campus)
description: Este curso está diseñado para proveedores de cuidado infantil y padres que buscan obtener una mejor comprensión del Trastorno por Déficit de Atención con Hiperactividad (TDAH) y el Trastorno del Espectro Autista en niños en edad preescolar. Los participantes aprenderán sobre los factores causales, el curso del desarrollo y los síntomas de estos trastornos infantiles comunes con un enfoque especial en disipar mitos y conceptos equivocados. Se discutirá sobre la intervención basada en la investigación y las estrategias de gestión del aula. Se introduciarán recursos para proveedores de cuidado infantil y padres enfocados en reforzar el desarrollo infantil positivo.

title: Manejo del Comportamiento (Homestead Campus)
description: En este curso tendrá la oportunidad de analizar las causas posibles de los problemas de comportamiento en los niños de edad preescolar. Conozca las estrategias para manejar los problemas del comportamiento de manera efectiva y sensible y cuáles son los comportamientos apropiados. Este curso de 45 horas, cubrirá las horas de servicio de entrenamiento anual y le permitirá adquirir 4.5 CEUs. El objetivo principal de este entrenamiento es, proveer herramientas que le sean útiles al personal docente, padres y, profesionales afines, para el manejo de comportamientos en niños.

title: CPR| BLS for Health Care Providers (Homestead Campus)
description: The Basic Life Support course is designed to teach the skills of CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) for victims of all ages, including ventilation with a barrier device, a bag-mask device and oxygen; use of an automated external defibrillator (AED); and relief of foreign-body airway obstruction (FBAO). This course is intended for participants who provide health care to patients in a wide variety of settings, inside and outside of a hospital. The course is also designed for anyone who is required to take a health care provider course for employment. (Anyone in the health field; Nurses; Doctors, Firefighters, etc...). title: CompTIA Security + (SY0-601) (Kendall Campus)
description: The CompTIA Security+ certification is the premier global credential that validates the essential knowledge and hands-on skills required for today’s core cybersecurity roles. Designed for IT professionals at the start or mid-level of their careers, Security+ prepares learners to secure networks, applications, and devices while ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) across enterprise systems. | This course provides comprehensive coverage of the Security+ exam objectives, focusing on practical, real-world applications to detect, prevent, and respond to evolving cyber threats. As one of the most widely recognized certifications in cybersecurity, Security+ serves as a trusted pathway to advancing in IT security roles such as security administrator, systems administrator, or SOC analyst, while also laying the foundation for advanced certifications like CySA+, CASP+, and CISSP. | Course Outline | • General Security Concepts. • Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations. • Security Architecture. • Security Operations. • Security Program Management and Oversight. Skills Learned: • Identify various types of threats, attacks, and vulnerabilities, including malware, social engineering, and application attacks. • Utilize security technologies and tools, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint security, to protect systems. • Design secure network architectures, implement secure systems, and apply secure protocols for architecture and design. • Manage identity and access concepts, including authentication, authorization, and accounting, to ensure secure access control. • Assess and manage risk through risk analysis, mitigation strategies, and business continuity planning. • Apply cryptography concepts, including encryption algorithms, public key infrastructure (PKI), and digital signatures, to secure data. • Implement compliance and operational security measures, including security policies, procedures, and best practices.

title: Teen Creator Studio (Ages 13-17) Summer Camp (Kendall Campus)
description: Find your voice and bring your ideas to life! In this hands-on course, teens explore podcasting and YouTube content creation while building confidence in public speaking, storytelling, and on-camera presentation. title: Intro to SEO for Small Business Owners (West Campus)
description: This course is designed to introduce small business owners to the fundamentals of Search Engine Optimization (SEO). SEO is the process of improving the quality and quantity of website traffic to a website or a web page from search engines. SEO targets unpaid traffic rather than direct traffic or paid traffic. The curriculum covers on-page and off-page SEO, content creation, and analytics. Participants will learn the basics of website indexation and technical SEO. The course will culminate in a practical project where students will apply what they've learned to their own business websites. | Learner Outcomes | Upon completion of the course, students will be able to demonstrate the following competencies: | Understand the basics of on-page and off-page SEO. | Develop content that is optimized for search engines. | Utilize analytics tools to measure the effectiveness of SEO strategies. | Understand website indexation and technical SEO fundamentals. | Implement SEO strategies to improve website visibility and traffic.

title: Dental Radiography (Medical Campus)
description: This course provides both theoretical and practical applications aiming to reinforce the essential dental radiography principles and procedures required for certification. It encompasses topics such as the fundamentals of radiography, dental radiography practice and equipment, radiation biology, radiation safety protocols, radiographic anatomy, radiography image, films, and processing, intra-oral radiographic methods, additional dental radiography techniques, as well as infection control and sterilization procedures. This dental radiography program complies with the radiography training requirements for dental assistants outlined in Chapter 64B-9.011 of the Florida state regulations. The required clinical offers personalized, practical clinical exposure using mannequins to assess competency in performing X-ray procedures and understanding Radiation Safety principles.

title: Expanded Functions Dental Auxiliary (Medical Campus)
description: This comprehensive course encompasses a wide range of dental procedures, including tasks such as dental charting, performing coronal polishing, taking alginate impressions, precision in pouring and refining study models, the application of pit and fissure sealants, administering topical fluorides, applying liners and bases, suture removal, eliminating excess dental cement, crafting temporary crowns, as well as the placement and removal of dental dams, matrix bands, retraction cords, temporary restorations, and periodontal dressings. Our Florida Board of Dentistry approved program offers a comprehensive educational experience designed to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to attain the Expanded Functions Certification. We are committed to providing our students with a thorough understanding of procedures as outlined in Rule Chapter 64B5-25, F.A.C., and in accordance with the dental practice act and administrative code.
